CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_access_fin_recebimentos()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles p
    where p.id = (select auth.uid())
      and p.ativo = true
      and (
        lower(trim(coalesce(p.tipo,''))) = 'administrador'
        or lower(trim(coalesce(p.tipo,''))) = 'financeiro'
        or lower(trim(coalesce(p.setor,''))) = 'financeiro'
      )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_manage_core()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select public.is_admin() or public.is_comercial();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles p
    where p.id = (select auth.uid())
      and p.tipo = 'Administrador'
      and p.ativo = true
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_comercial()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles p
    where p.id = (select auth.uid())
      and p.tipo = 'Comercial'
      and p.ativo = true
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_erp_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid()
      and p.ativo is true
      and lower(trim(p.tipo)) = lower('Administrador')
  );
$function$

 (modulo='marketing' and p.tipo in ('Marketing','Pós-protocolo'))))
$function$
